protocol.family: unit ramp + independent negative16/positive16 W4 cubic C1 half-splines
protocol.normalization: analytic continuous-phase zero mean of each correction; no window normalization
protocol.fitted_nuisance: phase of MIDI91 only; one output-window DC
protocol.phase_policy: prior notes canonical; training note91 nuisance phase; benchmark audio all canonical

phase_search.seeds: lowest strict cyclic local coarse minima plus the global coarse minimum
phase_search.refinement: bounded scalar minimization in one coarse step on either side; retain coarse fallback
phase_search.selection: training residual only; finite search, no global-optimality claim

protocol.linear_solve: unregularized float64 SVD, 32 source coefficients plus output DC; fixed unit ramp
protocol.invalid_phases: retain all scores and reasons; do not select rank-deficient or ill-conditioned solutions
protocol.control_gate: independent planted complete-engine audio must recover and transfer at canonical phase before hardware is loaded

content.interpretation: Actual canonical audio remains the benchmark; nonlinear prediction failures are retained, never hidden.

content.scope: same selected vector; complete dry MIDI and fitted-phase linearity audit
